Or s = [-2 - 7]/2 = -9/2 = -4.5 km/h (discard negative solution)

So, s = 2.5 km/h

Second equation: 9/(2.5 + 2) + t/60 = 9/4.5 + t/60 = 2 + t/60 = 2.4

s + 1/2 = 2.5 + 0.5 = 3 km/h
